description: Byte streams as a receiver reads them. Feeding 'chunks_hex' in order, or the same bytes split anywhere else, MUST produce 'events' in order. A frame event carries the header fields and payload; an error event names the first check that failed: oversize, cobs, short, crc, version, then oversize again for the decoded payload.

cases.name: the delimiter alone in the next read
garbage without a zero corrupts the frame it runs into
garbage ending in a zero is dropped on its own
a flipped bit fails the CRC
a lost byte in the middle
a frame shorter than header and CRC
an agent that died mid-frame restarts with a zero and READY
a trailing partial frame emits nothing yet
a frame encoded without its final empty block
to the agent: a frame at the size limit
to the agent: one byte past the encoded limit
to the agent: payload one byte too long, under the encoded limit
to the host: a frame at the size limit
to the host: one byte past the encoded limit
to the host: payload one byte too long, under the encoded limit
